evals.prompt: I just installed the Emailit plugin. What now?
evals.expected_output: Checks the connection with get-current-workspace, checks domains, and offers a test send to the user.
expectations: Offers a test email to the user before any other send

evals.expected_output: Gives the claude plugin or claude mcp add command for https://api.emailit.com/mcp and explains /mcp authentication.
expectations: Does not ask the user to paste an API key into chat

evals.prompt: Emailit tools say insufficient scope when I create a domain.
evals.expected_output: Explains the connection has sending scope and that reconnecting with full access fixes it.
expectations: Names the sending and full scopes
Suggests reconnecting and approving full access
Does not suggest a workaround that bypasses scopes
